files.bloch_midpoint.smt2:
(set-logic QF_BV)
(declare-const lo (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const hi (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const m (_ BitVec 32))
(assert (bvugt lo (_ bv0 32)))
(assert (bvugt hi (_ bv0 32)))
(assert (= m (bvlshr (bvadd lo hi) (_ bv1 32))))
(assert (bvult m lo))
(check-sat)

files.ipv4_dirty_net.smt2:
(set-logic QF_BV)
(declare-const ip (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const mask (_ BitVec 32))
(declare-const net (_ BitVec 32))
(assert (= mask (_ bv4294967040 32)))
(assert (= ip (_ bv3232235777 32)))
(assert (= net (_ bv3232236033 32)))
(assert (not (= (bvand ip mask) (bvand net mask))))
(check-sat)
